description: This file defines error handling constants, functions for interpreting database error messages, and mappings for different database providers used in the ADODB PHP library. It provides mechanisms to translate error codes and messages into standardized error constants for use in database operations.

methods.name: adodb_errormsg
methods.description: Returns a localized error message based on the error code provided.

methods.name: adodb_error
methods.description: Maps database provider error codes to standard error constants.

methods.name: adodb_error_pg
methods.description: Handles error message parsing for PostgreSQL errors.

methods.name: adodb_error_odbc
methods.description: Provides a mapping of ODBC error codes to internal error constants.

methods.name: adodb_error_ibase
methods.description: Provides a mapping of InterBase error codes to internal error constants.

methods.name: adodb_error_ifx
methods.description: Provides a mapping of Informix error codes to internal error constants.

methods.name: adodb_error_oci8
methods.description: Provides a mapping of Oracle OCI8 error codes to internal error constants.

methods.name: adodb_error_mssql
methods.description: Provides a mapping of MS SQL Server error codes to internal error constants.

methods.name: adodb_error_sqlite
methods.description: Provides a mapping of SQLite error codes to internal error constants.

methods.name: adodb_error_mysql
methods.description: Provides a mapping of MySQL error codes to internal error constants.
